tools.description: Teacher-force up to 8 texts (max 2048 tokens each) using base or current weights, with no gradients. Capture all layer hidden states and optional module input/output vectors at up to 32 token positions (negative indices allowed). modules are full module names, e.g. a tensor name with its final .weight removed. Returns an artifact: texts is a list, each with tokens, positions, hidden (array of layers x positions x width), modules (dict name -> input/output arrays). Module names are drawn from the public target architecture. One forward-call budget unit.
